description: Stop a deployment now: billing ends at this minute and its container and NVMe scratch disk are deleted and cannot be recovered. A request that has not started is withdrawn at no cost. Make sure results are copied off, tell the user the disk is deleted, and get a yes first.

confirm.description: Must be true. It states that the user approved this exact action after seeing what it does and costs. With a sandbox key (tml_test_…) nothing is real and it may be set freely.

id.description: The deployment id (rnt_… on a live key, snd_… in the sandbox).

name: stop_deployment
title: Stop a deployment
